proposal.hypothesis: Cooperatively stage each 256-source tile's x, y, z, and mass values in 4 KiB of static shared memory so the block's output threads reuse them instead of repeatedly fetching those source fields from global memory. The sequential pairwise arithmetic and one-output-per-active-thread strategy remain close to baseline; barriers and shared-memory occupancy costs may offset the reduced global loads, so this is a performance hypothesis for measurement.

retained: Stage source x, y, z, and mass in four 256-element shared-memory arrays, loading each tile cooperatively.
Synchronize after tile loads and after tile consumption so all output lanes, including tail-block lanes, safely participate before shared storage is reused.
Keep the source-particle accumulation in ascending tile/source order and guard output work and writes with i < n.
